items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: guitarists like Tiny, Tiny used to play with us

ctx.x: Did you -- who were some of the other guys that you remember who liked the cards?

Well, of course, guitarists like Tiny, Tiny used to play with us, and Everett Barksdale, he was with us at one time, John Collins. And quite a few other musicians at times when we were at one or the other's house, you know, had a little party or something, you know, start playing cards, because that was, oh, Art Tatum's favorite sport-like, you might say.

items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I think once we were playing a gig, a guitarist sat in Tiny's place... Art Tatum and I and Tiny and a lot of musicians used to frequent this particular place.

ctx.x: How was -- how did Tiny Grimes respond to the band? How did the guys --
Well, Tiny -- it was quite a chore for Tiny. He possibly couldn't hear as well as I could. He was -- Every once in a while he would -- he wouldn't be playing. He
wouldn't be keeping up with it, you know. He laid out quite a few times.
